mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing a new exterior door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a new exterior door typically involves carefully removing the old door and frame, preparing the opening, ensuring the new frame is plumb and level, installing the new door, adding weatherstripping for energy efficiency, and finally installing the chosen hardware and trim. Our process includes a thorough site assessment to identify any structural issues that might impact the installation, especially common in older homes found throughout the East Bay.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior door installation involves removing the old door, preparing the opening, installing the new frame and door, adding weatherstripping, and fitting hardware. We include a site assessment for structural integrity.
